text: Pursuant to the relevant provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as amended, please find enclosed a press release dated 12th November 2026, regarding the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations and further to our intimation dated 7th November 2026, we wish to inform the stock exchanges that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on Thursday, 12th November 2026, has, inter alia, considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet

In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated 11th July 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited (formerly known as IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited), a material subsidiary of the Company, has filed the Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated 6th November 2026, on 7th November 2026 with the SEBI, BSE and NSE in connection with its proposed Initial Public Offer.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed the acquisition of the balance 40% equity stake of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited ("Power-One") from Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Venna, shareholders of Power-One, pursuant to Share Swap agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Power-One a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 1,76,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A3 have been allotted by IL JIN to Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Veena, as a non -cash consideration, for the aforesaid, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed acquisition of the balance 1.50% equity stake of Ascent Circuits Private Limited ("Ascent Circuits"), from Ms. Manju Thomas, shareholder of Ascent Circuits, pursuant to Share Swap Agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Ascent Circuits Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 13,120 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A2 have been allotted by IL JIN to Ms. Manju Thomas, as non-cash consideration, for the aforesaid acquisition, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to inform the exchange that, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company has entered into a Share Swap Agreement on 18th October 2026, in terms of the said agreement IL JIN shall acquire 1,75,680 equity share of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited, representing its balance 40% equity stake on fully dilutive basis, from existing equity shareholders of Power-one and shall issue and allot 1,76,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Share (CCPS A3) to the sellers as non-cash consideration. Upon completion of the aforesaid transaction, Power-One shall become wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN and the Company.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to inform the exchange that, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company has entered into a Share Swap Agreement on 18th October 2026, in terms of the said agreement IL JIN shall acquire 1,75,680 equity share of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited, representing its balance 40% equity stake on fully dilutive basis, from existing equity shareholders of Power-one and shall issue and allot 1,76,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Share (CCPS A3) to the sellers as non-cash consideration. Upon completion of the aforesaid transaction, Power-One shall become wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN and the Company.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to inform the exchange that, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company has entered into a Share Swap Agreement on 18th October 2026, in terms of the said agreement IL JIN shall acquire 23,401 equity shares of Ascent Circuits representing the balance 1.50% of its equity stake on fully dilutive basis, from Ms. Manju Thomas and shall issue and allot 13,120 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS A2) of an issue price of Rs. 10,000 per CCPS A2 (Including a Premium amount of Rs. 9,990 per CCPS A2) to Ms. Manju Thomas as non-cash consideration. Upon Completion of the aforesaid transaction, Ascent Circuits shall become wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN and the Company.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to inform the exchange that, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company has entered into a Share Swap Agreement on 18th October 2026, in terms of the said agreement IL JIN shall acquire 23,401 equity shares of Ascent Circuits representing the balance 1.50% of its equity stake on fully dilutive basis, from Ms. Manju Thomas and shall issue and allot 13,120 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS A2) of an issue price of Rs. 10,000 per CCPS A2 (Including a Premium amount of Rs. 9,990 per CCPS A2) to Ms. Manju Thomas as non-cash consideration. Upon Completion of the aforesaid transaction, Ascent Circuits shall become wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN and the Company.
Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP

We hereby inform the exchange that the Board of Directors of IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited (Formerly known as IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited) at its meeting held on 16th October 2026 approved the appointment of Mr. Satendra Singh as Chief Executive Officer and Whole Time Director of IL JIN with effect from 16th October 2026 for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years. Further, the Board of IL JIN has also noted the cessation of Mr. Sanjay Kumar Arora as Whole Time Director of IL JIN with effect from close of business hours on 16th October 2026.
